description: This file defines the trait 'CliRunnerTrait' in the 'SuiteCRM\Robo\Traits' namespace. The trait provides a 'bootstrap' method to initialize and configure a SuiteCRM instance for CLI usage by setting global variables, including configuration files, and preparing the environment for database connection and other operations.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the environment for SuiteCRM to run from CLI by setting global variables, including necessary configuration files, and setting language and resource limits.
